arcs.name: Revival
arcs.summary: Struggling manga artist Satoru Fujinuma has an ability he calls Revival that sends him back minutes before a tragedy.
events: Satoru saves a boy from a truck using Revival.
His mother is murdered and he is framed, then sent back to 1988 when he was eleven.

arcs.name: 1988: Saving Kayo
arcs.summary: Back in his childhood, Satoru tries to stop the serial kidnapping that began with his classmate Kayo Hinazuki.
events: Satoru notices Kayo's bruises and invites her to his birthday party.
He uncovers the abuse Kayo suffers from her mother.
The danger date passes, but Kayo still disappears.

arcs.name: Fugitive in 2006
arcs.summary: Thrown back to the present, Satoru is on the run as the prime suspect.
events: Coworker Airi shelters Satoru and is caught in an arson fire.
Satoru rescues Airi and gets help from journalist Sawada.
He is arrested after spotting the real killer.

arcs.name: Second Revival
arcs.summary: Satoru returns to 1988 again and takes bolder steps to protect Kayo.
events: Satoru hides Kayo in an old bus with her consent.
Kayo stays with Satoru's family as they confront her mother.
Kayo goes to live with her grandmother and Satoru turns to the other potential victims.

arcs.name: The Killer
arcs.summary: With Kayo safe, Satoru shifts his focus to the remaining targets.
events: Teacher Gaku Yashiro reveals himself as the killer and drives Satoru into a frozen lake.

arcs.name: Future
arcs.summary: Satoru wakes up years later and must finish what he started.
events: Satoru wakes in 2003 after fifteen years in a coma.
Yashiro's rooftop plot fails and he is arrested.
A 2010 epilogue shows Satoru reunited with Airi.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga.
